result.summary: The page is largely intact; the explicitly excluded carousel-edge clipping and bottom-viewport cutoff were not counted. The main visible defect is in the bottom navigation where the Orders tab appears to lack its icon, plus a minor low-contrast secondary text concern.

issues.description: The bottom navigation 'Orders' tab shows a text label but no visible icon above it, unlike Home, Search, and Profile which all have icons.
issues.suggestion: Add or restore the Orders/receipt icon so all bottom navigation items have consistent icon-plus-label treatment.

issues.description: Secondary metadata text such as delivery fees and '25–35 min · €0 delivery · Ramen' uses light gray on white and may have weak contrast for some users.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text color slightly or increase font weight to improve readability while preserving hierarchy.
